items.title: The sharp maximum cut dimension of an n-vertex weighted undirected graph is 2n minus 3
items.author: Troy Lee; Tongyang Li; Miklos Santha; Shengyu Zhang

items.difficulty_reason: The authors uncross minimum cuts into a spanning cross-free family, bound its size through laminar shores, and use a rooted-tree representation and flow-based edge weights to attain the bound while keeping those cut vectors independent.
